differences_from_upstream: Pinned legacy parquet replaces the unversioned HF loader; row contents/schema are preserved.
Qwen3-235B tokenizer replaces the reference Mistral-7B tokenizer; no model weights are loaded here.
UUID4 entropy uses an independent fixed Python RNG and standard UUIDv4 version/variant bits; upstream uses OS entropy.
Python and NumPy are explicitly seeded immediately before preparation, instead of relying on entrypoint import order.
NumPy MT19937 seed is explicitly reset before arrival generation; upstream shares global NumPy state with dataset shuffle.
Archived arrivals omit only the upstream dummy final sleep entry; there is one deadline per request.
Added document/request metadata and archived text/input_ids do not change generation or ordering.
Current recorded dependency versions replace the original unpinned dependency environment.

data.post_validation_change: Removed one blank line after imports to satisfy repository isort; executable AST unchanged.

operational_note: One failed preflight before sending requests was archived separately. The runner resumed after enabling SO_REUSEADDR. The first completed trial retains the original phase/runner manifest; later trials also reference a separate execution manifest. No completed trial was replaced.
comparison_scope: Full reference Preble global routing with virtual eviction cost and rebalancing + MPQ, versus round-robin global routing + native LPM. Both use the same modern worker runtime, chunked prefill 512, real BF16 235B weights, effective seeds, and backend settings. All MPQ trials precede LPM; baseline rates run in reverse order. This does not isolate global routing alone and is not the paper hardware/model/trace.
